lines.trans: Chef, I have big problems.
What happened again, runt?
A terrible prosecutor is looking for me.
And why is he looking for you?
He knows about me and Vika.
You slept with someone else's woman?
I did not know that she is married.
He was the most talented cook.
Whom I ever knew.
Chef, are you already burying me?
You don't mess with a prosecutor.
He will quickly send you behind bars.
What should I do now?
Go work and do not chat.
